content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD momentum-equation source-term assembly: single SUBROUTINE SourceTerms (L56-548; history L48-53: 05/01/2010 Fengyan Shi, 09/26/2013 Babak Tehranirad 2D Cd, 08/18/2015 YoungKwang Choi viscosity breaking, 02/08/2016 conservative-form wavemaker correction). Optionally uses VESSEL_MODULE/METEO_MODULE/PRECIPITATION_MODULE (L58-66). Part 1 - wavemaker mass source WaveMaker_Mass over the wavemaker window jlo:jhi/ilo:ihi, optimized per Salatin et al. 2021 JGR-Oceans doi:10.1029/2021JC017641 (citation L95-99; note L104-105 only WK_NEW_IRR/WK_NEW_DATA2D are from that reference, others 'only optimized'): 'WK_REG' Wei-Kirby regular source AA*EXP(-Beta_gen*(x-Xc_WK)**2)*SIN(rlamda*y-2*PI/Tperiod*TIME) with ramp AA=TANH(PI/(Time_ramp*Tperiod)*TIME)*D_gen (L109-116); 'WK_IRR'/'TMA_1D'/'JON_1D'/'JON_2D'/'WK_NEW_IRR' sum over Nfreq of AA*(Cm*COS(OMGN_IR*t)+Sm*SIN(OMGN_IR*t)) with precomputed BB/CC (L117-134); 'WK_TIME' (marked 'Not tested' L135) sums NumWaveComp components D_genS*EXP(-Beta_genS*(x-Xc_WK)**2)*COS(2*PI/WAVE_COMP(kf,1)*t-WAVE_COMP(kf,3)) (L135-149); 'WK_DATA2D' same Cm/Sm sum over NumFreq with OMGN2D (L150-165); 'WK_NEW_DATA2D' restricts the frequency sum to loop_index entries (L166-183). Part 2 - eddy viscosity field nu_vis=nu_break when VISCOSITY_BREAKING or WAVEMAKER_VIS (L196-198, ykchoi/fyshi comments L191-193), plus VisVessel_2D (DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL L200-201), plus nu_sponge when DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L213-224). Part 3 - main loop over interior (L229-534), CARTESIAN branch (L232-458): bottom friction FrcInsX/FrcInsY either Manning form -(GRAV*Cd**2/Max(H,MinDepthFrc)**0.333333)*U*|U| (MANNING, L238-240) or quadratic -Cd*U*|U| (L242); SourceX = GRAV*Eta/DX*(Depthx(I+1,J)-Depthx(I,J))*MASK + FrcInsX + Gamma1*MASK9*Max(H,MinDepthFrc)*(u.grad(U4)+U4.grad(u)-Gamma2*MASK9*(U1pp+U2+U3)) + Gamma1*MASK9*div(P,Q)*(U4-U1p) + WaveMaker_Mass*U (L246-260; SourceY analogue L305-319); optional additive drags: FRICTION_SPONGE -CD_4_SPONGE*U*|U|*Depth (L262-267; comment L263 'compared to wei et al, we used flux. so need multiply D'), DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL -CdVessel_2D*U*|U| (L269-272), WaveMakerCurrentBalance -WaveMakerCd*U*|U| inside the wavemaker box |x-Xc_WK|<Width_WK, |y-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L274-287; global coords via iista/jjsta L276-277), BREAKWATER -CD_breakwater*U*|U|*Depth (L289-294); METEO wind stress +MASK_WIND*RHO_AW*Cdw*WindU2D*|Wind| (L355-364); MIXING Smagorinsky lateral mixing on P/Q with nu_smg (L367-388); breaking/diffusion viscosity terms (L394-458): PQ_scheme=.TRUE. path applies div(nu_vis grad P)/-style forms on P/Q (L401-423) but PQ_scheme is hardcoded .FALSE. (L70) because 'P and Q are not exchanged at processor interface, it affects edges' (comment L398-399), so the used path computes BreakSourceX=div(nu_vis grad HU) and BreakSourceY=div(nu_vis grad HV) with cell-averaged nu_vis (L428-453), saved for dissipation analysis (comment L426). Non-CARTESIAN (spherical) branch (L459-531): SourceX/Y = GRAV*Eta*SlopeX/Y*MASK + friction + Gamma1*MASK9*div(P,Q)*(U4-U1p) (ZALPHA branch L463-495) or *(-U1p)/(-V1p) (default L496-528), plus Coriolis +Coriolis*0.5*(Q(I,J)+Q(I,J+1)) in X and -Coriolis*0.5*(P(I,J)+P(I+1,J)) in Y (L478/L495/L511/L528); no wavemaker/mixing/breakwater terms in the spherical branch. Finally adds VESSEL pressure gradients VesselPressureX/Y (L536-539) and METEO storm-surge pressure gradients StormPressureX/Y when AirPressure (L541-546) as whole-array sums.

verbatim_spans.text: !       02/08/2016 Fengyan Shi, corrected wavemaker corresponding to
! Only WK_NEW_IRR and WK_NEW_DATA2D are from the above reference
!      it turns out P and Q are not exchanged at processor interface
! note that, compared to wei et al, we used flux. so need multiply D

unresolved: nu_vis declared plain REAL @L69 (not REAL(SP)) unlike all other arrays - precision mismatch if SP is double
PQ_scheme hardcoded .FALSE. @L70 makes the P/Q-based viscosity path L401-423 dead code; comment L398-399 explains the parallel exchange limitation that motivated it

Cartesian and spherical branches are asymmetric: the spherical branch (L459-531) lacks wavemaker source in momentum, friction/diffusion sponges, breakwater, wind, mixing, deep-draft and current-balance terms and uses SlopeX/SlopeY instead of Depthx differences; only the Cartesian branch adds WaveMaker_Mass*U (L260)
ZALPHA spherical variant uses (U4-U1p)/(V4-V1p) (L476, L493) while the default spherical variant uses (-U1p)/(-V1p) (L509, L526) in the Ht dispersion term
BB/CC dimensioned Nfreq @L76 but BB2/CC2 dimensioned NumFreq @L78 - two different global sizes for irregular vs DATA2D wavemakers; WK_TIME branch marked 'Not tested' @L135
DEEP_DRAFT_VESSEL drag blocks @L269-272/@L327-330 are compiled inside the loop without an IF guard other than the preprocessor - they always apply when the macro is defined
Statement label 107 format @L226 is never referenced; locals kd @L72 and xmk_wk/ymk_wk-based WK_TIME branch reuse of Xc_WK only (no Yc_WK dependence for 1D components)

Wavemaker mass source is added to momentum as WaveMaker_Mass*U/V (L260, L319) consistent with the 02/08/2016 conservative-form correction (comment L52-53); the mass-equation counterpart lives elsewhere
Wind stress term (L357-362) is not multiplied by MASK(I,J) (only MASK_WIND) and lacks the (rho_air/rho_water) density ratio unless RHO_AW already encodes it
